{{Quote|Admiral Heggel, it is such an honor to have you visit our system.|Commander Resner|<ref name="GK" />}}
'''Resner''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. He commanded a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], and was questioned over [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] activity within the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Heggel]].
